# KDnuggets

> > KDnuggets is a leading data science and machine learning resource providing tutorials, guides, and tools for AI agents, Python development, and LLM applications.

KDnuggets offers practical guides and resources for data scientists, machine learning engineers, and AI developers. The site focuses on emerging technologies including AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), large language models (LLMs), and developer tools for building intelligent applications.

## Key Topics

- AI Agents
- Web Search APIs
- Python
- Large Language Models (LLM)
- Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
- Tavily
- Exa
- Firecrawl
- SERP APIs
- Agentic AI
- Free APIs
- LLM Tools
- Markdown & HTML Processing
- Python Integration

## AI Agents & Tools

- [7 Free Web Search APIs for AI Agents](https://www.kdnuggets.com/7-free-web-search-apis-for-ai-agents): Guide to free web search APIs like Tavily, Exa, Firecrawl for AI agents
